title: Socialism in Europe and the Russian Revolution
subtitle: Understanding the Rise of Socialism and the Fall of the Tsars
subject: Social Science (History)
author: Shine Academy Naroda AI
learning_outcomes: Understand the social and political conditions of pre-revolutionary Russia.
Explain the emergence of socialism in Europe.
Analyze the causes and consequences of the Russian Revolution of 1917.
Draw parallels between Russian socialist thought and ancient Indian societal structures.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the timeline, key figures, and ideological shifts of the Russian Revolution and early European socialism.
common_misconceptions: Socialism and Communism are exactly the same.
The Russian Revolution was a single event rather than a series of revolutions (1905, Feb 1917, Oct 1917).
ai_context.tutor_hint: If a student struggles, ask: 'Imagine if workers in your city suddenly took control of all factories. What rules would they set? This was the core idea of Soviet worker councils.'
